device.method: ASDPurchase startPurchase with appExtVrsId pinned buy params via itunesstored-entitled CLI, then in-process FairPlay dump with bfdecrypt 1.3.5 (UIKit injection). Output cryptid 0 verified per binary with otool.

notes: First iOS IPA preservation run. The four artifacts were uploaded to the apps-ios-s2 Release and reconciled against GitHub server-reported SHA-256 digests. Encrypted counterparts intentionally discarded; SC_Info sinf contains account-identifying material. iTunesMetadata.plist retained on-device only; provenance fields (external_version_id, build, minimum_os_version) copied into data/apps/ios-archive.json. Remaining ~93 S2 versions and 7 S1 versions pending subsequent runs.
